# noozle_nats_jetstream_outlet (Data Source)

Reads a Noozle NATS JetStream outlet by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

data "noozle_nats_jetstream_outlet" "alerts" {
  id = 123
}
```
